notes.title: Update Notes for Demo Beta #4
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Hand rotation should now be correct on all headsets
[*] Cones no longer collide with an invisible body on the Maestro
[/list]

New features:
[list]
[*] Wheels now spin on cars as they move
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] New pointer for the menu
[*] Changed hand animation time
[*] Slight menu font color changes
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Demo Beta 2
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Bell could be rung with the results menu open
[*] The cup spawned on its side sometimes
[*] Cars did not always despawn at the end of their route
[/list]

New Features:
[list]
[*] Pressing ` will open the developer console
[*] New developer command: [i]time off[/i]
Stops in-game time, allowing a level to be played indefinitely.
[/list]
